answer: Graph-embedding redundancy check. Each agent must be reachable from the trusted core through at least three disjoint paths, and the registry stores a vault of signed neighbor lists that are continuously cross-checked. A lone identity can claim many links, but its marble of connectivity collapses when paths reconverge on the same few relays. Enforcement scores every sonnet of topology data against random-graph baselines; clusters whose internal path diversity falls below threshold are quarantined.
